args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to us-east, us-west, eu-west) was failing health checks with an error rate of ~18%. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. The SRE agent rolled checkout-api back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback status: rolled_out/verified. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Cause:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in all three regions. The service shows as healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2) says what failed, which regions were affected, what I rolled back to and that it worked. It also notes that the v2.3.1 problem needs to be found before anyone redeploys it.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
